name: Ritz Penha Longa Resort
insider_take: This isn't just another luxury resort – it's a 650-acre Portuguese paradise where championship golf meets fairy-tale castles, all wrapped in Ritz-Carlton elegance just 30 minutes from Lisbon.
whats_special: Built around a restored 14th-century monastery, this resort sits in the mystical hills of Sintra – a UNESCO World Heritage site. The property features two championship golf courses designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr., including the Atlantic Championship Course that hosted the Portuguese Open. You're literally neighbors with Pena Palace, one of Europe's most spectacular Romantic castles.
pro_tip: Book a spa treatment using the ancient Roman-inspired Penha Longa Springs – the natural mineral waters have been prized for their healing properties since medieval times.
dont_miss: The sunrise hot air balloon rides over Sintra's enchanted landscape, and definitely explore the mysterious Quinta da Regaleira with its underground tunnels and mystical gardens – it's a 10-minute drive that feels like stepping into a Dan Brown novel.
pros: Championship 27-hole golf course designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr.
Historic 14th-century monastery setting with UNESCO World Heritage surroundings
Luxury spa with comprehensive wellness treatments and facilities
Multiple dining venues including Michelin-starred restaurant options
cons: Remote location requires transportation to reach Sintra town center
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and extensive facilities
